description: Dated per-quarter snapshots of a product's pricing page. Returns observations, NOT a trend figure — CostBench does not publish one, because diffing snapshots across renamed/restructured plan lineups is ~90% measurement artifact.

slug.description: Product slug (e.g. "salesforce") or product name (e.g. "HubSpot CRM"). Near-misses return did-you-mean suggestions.
